title: System Visibility
hook: If you can't tell me your numbers without logging into five tools, you're flying blind.
statement: You can't improve what you can't see. And seeing a number only helps if you know what it means.
explainer: Most founders run on gut feel until something breaks. A simple tracker shows problems early, while they're still small and cheap to fix.
sop: Pick the 3 metrics that actually show if your business is healthy.
Rate your Visibility into each from 1 to 10.
Build a simple tracker for anything you can't see right now.
Rate your Understanding from 1 to 10. Do you know what good looks like?
Review it on the same day every week, not just when something feels off.
equation_example: Visibility 7, Understanding 6. 7 × 6 = 42 out of 100. You can see some of it and read some of it. Higher means you're acting on what's really happening. Lower means you're blind or misreading the data.
question: Name the one part of your business you're running blind on right now.
closing_statement: A number you never check isn't managing anything.
caption:
Principle Nº 146: System Visibility

If you can't tell me your numbers without logging into five tools, you're flying blind.

You can't improve what you can't see. And seeing a number only helps if you know what it means.

Your turn: Name the one part of your business you're running blind on right now.
